_comment: v1.5 PR-6a §D — the HOLDOUT routing fixtures. Written by hand from the same recipes as routing.dev.json, in one pass, BEFORE any accuracy number was measured, and never tuned to make a number look better: the suite reports this accuracy without gating on it, so it stays honest. ROUND 2 (review findings C6/Q8/Q9), stated exactly, because an earlier version of this note miscounted its own edits: 6 rows were ADDED (2 operator, 2 url, 2 out-of-scope) and 1 row ("give me the list of people in my contacts") was NARROWED to a single acceptable answer. Nothing was removed and no row was widened. Two of the six added rows MISS on the current router, which is the evidence that they were not written to pass. PROVENANCE CAVEAT: this file was first committed in the same commit as the router source, so the git record cannot prove the ordering — the claim rests on this note, and a reviewer who wants certainty should judge the rows on their face instead. If a future PR edits this file it must say so in the PR body: an edit here is the only way the honest number can be faked.
